properties.name: hison.utils.format.date
properties.description: Default date pattern used by date utilities (e.g. yyyy-MM-dd).

properties.name: hison.utils.format.datetime
properties.description: Default datetime pattern used by datetime utilities (e.g. yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

properties.name: hison.utils.type.date-add
properties.description: Default unit for addDate() when no addType is given (y, M, d, h, m, s).

properties.name: hison.utils.type.date-diff
properties.description: Default unit for getDateDiff() when no diffType is given (y, M, d, h, m, s).

properties.name: hison.utils.type.dayofweek
properties.description: Default output format for getDayOfWeek() (e.g. numeric index or day name).

properties.name: hison.utils.charbyte.less2047
properties.description: Byte length counted for a character whose code point is <= 0x7FF (default 2). Must be an integer.

properties.name: hison.utils.charbyte.less65535
properties.description: Byte length counted for a character whose code point is <= 0xFFFF (default 3). Must be an integer.

properties.name: hison.utils.charbyte.greater65535
properties.description: Byte length counted for a character whose code point is > 0xFFFF (default 4). Must be an integer.

properties.name: hison.utils.format.number
properties.description: Default number format pattern used by getNumberFormat() (e.g. #,##0.#####).

properties.name: hison.utils.property.file.path
properties.description: Base classpath prefix used to locate property files loaded by getProperties()/getPropertyValue().

properties.name: hison.utils.propertie.file.path
properties.description: Deprecated (misspelled) alias of 'hison.utils.property.file.path'. Kept for backward compatibility; prefer the corrected key.
